g.text: Which band is this? The library decides
Ambiguity is settled by evidence, not a coin toss — and “I don’t know” is one of the honest answers.
A name, and what it could mean
Four outcomes — three of them refuse
‘Delirium’ · no MusicBrainz tag in the files
The same lookup Lidarr uses when adding an
Unrelated bands share a name · they do not
The library cannot tell them apart,
and what each had in common
The check is a VETO, not a requirement. A single candidate used to be taken on trust — and exactly one artist in
MusicBrainz is called ‘Nihilismo’ — a punk band sharing not one album with the four under that name here.
The panel offered eight of its records.
A catalogue that cannot be read proves nothing, so it lets the match stand. An artist MusicBrainz happens
not to cover must not stop resolving.
Titles are compared with one rule in one place. When identification and the missing list answered
‘does the library have this?’ differently, a correctly matched artist read as a stranger.
Unresolved names are retried with exponential backoff, not on every pass —
